# P1.03 — Autosave, collab service, restore points

Spec: `docs/tickets/31_P1.03__autosave-collab-restore.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.03.md`
**Stage A only** — all code + deterministic tests. Stage B (deploy `collab` + `web` to `dev`, bounded
live WSS verify) is operator-gated → **D-P1.03-1**; $0 inference either way.

## Summary

Editing stops being a debounced POST. Keystrokes land in a `Y.Doc` backed by `y-indexeddb`
(survives refresh/crash), sync through the self-hosted Hocuspocus service in `apps/collab`, and
materialize server-side into canonical markdown + restore points. The only UI is the sync pill —
no Save button, no unsaved-changes dialog, no `beforeunload`. Single-user at MVP.

## What landed

**`apps/collab`** — the real service (replaces the healthz skeleton): Hono HTTP (`/healthz`,
block-patch routes) + Hocuspocus over `ws` upgrades. `onAuthenticate` resolves the session cookie,
binds the draft's workspace to the tenant, detects frozen forks (refusal code `frozen_fork`), and
attaches read-only under run locks/non-editable heads. `onLoadDocument` loads `live_docs.y_state`
or seeds from promoted canonical markdown. `onStoreDocument` debounces: persists the Yjs state +
state vector, materializes canonical markdown + `md_sha256`, writes revision/version rows, and
handles lock/fork transitions — frozen heads fork to `v(N+1) human_revision` on first stored write
(frozen bytes immutable). `onStateless` accepts provenance captures and `rhema.restore` named/blur
triggers, broadcasting acks. `afterUnloadDocument` clears runtime state. **Wiring note:**
`handleConnection` returns a `ClientConnection` that must be retained and fed — socket `message`/`close`
events forward to `connection.handleMessage`/`handleClose`; the call alone attaches no listeners.

**Restore points** (§11.4, REQ-IDE-34 storage half, F12): daily snapshot blobs + Yjs update deltas;
reconstruction applies deltas over the snapshot and re-materializes — **byte-identical markdown is
the test**. `⌘S` and page-hide send stateless `rhema.restore` messages; the sweeper expires unnamed
points per plan tier while keeping named points and the latest snapshot.

**Block-patch (M17)** — `@rhema/contracts` `block-patch.ts`: `{blockId, kind, markdown, hash}` read
model, view, `baseHash`+`markdown` patch request, typed errors (`hash_mismatch`→409, `frozen_head`,
`locked`, `block_not_found`). `apps/collab/src/blocks.ts` applies patches in a Yjs transaction
tagged `human_mobile`. Mobile client is 1.x.

**Browser transport** (`apps/web/src/client/collab.ts`) — `Y.Doc` + `IndexeddbPersistence` +
`HocuspocusProvider`, document name `draft:<draftId>`, fragment `"prosemirror"`, `?intent=ro` reads.
The session cookie authenticates the WSS upgrade — no credentials in the bundle. Provider state maps
to the verbatim §5.10 pill vocabulary (`synced ✓` / `syncing…` / `offline · n changes queued` /
`read-only`). On `frozen_fork` the client rebinds **the same Y.Doc** to the new head — pending
offline edits merge into `v(N+1)` instead of being dropped.

**`@rhema/editor`** — `createCollabPageState` (ySync+yUndo plugins replace prosemirror-history for
collab sessions). **`@rhema/db`** — `session.ts` (shared session helpers, used by api + collab) +
migration `0028_collab_restore.sql` (`rhema_collab` limited-role grants; `restore_points.cause`
check extension). **`@rhema/mirror`** — `restorePointMode` on `saveManualRevision`.

**Infra** — collab Cloud Run service `maxScale=1` (Redis multi-instance sync is deferred to sharing
roles, 1.x); `DATABASE_URL` (limited role) + `OBJECTS_BUCKET`; artifacts-bucket grant on the collab
SA; LB path rules `/collab` + `/collab/*` → collab; `COLLAB_WS_URL = wss://<app-domain>/collab` on
web (same-origin WSS — cookie rides the upgrade); no provider keys to collab.

## Out of scope (ticket-stated)

Multi-user collab / presence / the Redis scaling extension (1.x with sharing roles), restore-point
dropdown/preview UI (P1.08), mobile block-patch client (1.x, REQ-MOBILE-6), working copies
(REQ-DATA-27, 1.x), share-link reads (REQ-DATA-43, 1.x).

## Test plan

- [x] Two Hocuspocus providers converge over a real socket; reconnect resumes server + local state
- [x] Debounced materialization → canonical markdown + `md_sha256`
- [x] Run-locked head attaches read-only, never materializes; frozen head forks `v(N+1)
      human_revision`, refuses the next write-intent connect, frozen bytes untouched
- [x] Snapshot+delta restore reconstructs byte-identical markdown; `⌘S` named point; per-plan sweep
- [x] Missing session + cross-workspace refused at `onAuthenticate`
- [x] Block-patch: 409 `hash_mismatch`, `frozen_head` refusal, `human_mobile` Yjs apply
- [ ] Stage B: `pulumi up dev`, live WSS asserts, operator click-through — **D-P1.03-1**, operator-gated

## Notes for reviewers

- The Hocuspocus upgrade handler retains the `handleConnection` return value and forwards
  `ws` `message`/`close` events to it — required for the connection to function.
- Sync pill strings are the spec's verbatim lowercase vocabulary — do not re-title-case them.
- `intent=ro` attaches read-only; write intent on a frozen head gets `frozen_fork` → the client
  rebinds the same `Y.Doc` so queued offline edits merge into `v(N+1)`.
- Merge policy: **OPERATOR** — do not merge; stacked on PR #56
  (`stevevitali/p1-02-page-editor`).
